name.fr-FR: Correspondance de saint Vincent de Paul, tome I
name.en-US: Correspondence of St. Vincent de Paul, vol. I
name.pt-BR: Correspondência de São Vicente de Paulo, tomo I

description.fr-FR: Les lettres 1 à 416 de la Correspondance de saint Vincent, tome I de l’édition de Pierre Coste (1616-1639), une lettre par chapitre, groupées par année, avec les lettres adressées à Vincent que Coste y a intercalées, ses notices de sources et ses notes.
description.en-US: Letters 1 to 416 of St. Vincent’s Correspondence, vol. I of Pierre Coste’s edition (1616-1639), one letter per chapter and grouped by year, with the letters addressed to Vincent that Coste interleaves, his source notices and notes.
description.pt-BR: As cartas 1 a 416 da Correspondência de São Vicente, tomo I da edição de Pierre Coste (1616-1639).

sources.edition: Saint Vincent de Paul, Correspondance, entretiens, documents, éd. Pierre Coste C.M., Paris: Gabalda, 1920-1925, tome I; digital edition by P. Claude Lautissier C.M. and the Daughters of Charity (1992), on JesusMarie.com.
sources.description: All letters of the tome, one per chapter, including the letters to Vincent that Coste prints among them, with Coste’s source notices and footnotes kept as notes. Coste’s introduction is not included; letters whose heading the transcription lost stay inside the preceding chapter.
sources.tierEvidence: Vincent died in 1660; Coste’s edition appeared in 1920-25 and Coste died in 1935. The digital transcription is of the same text, with Coste’s notes.
